# Test Scenario: Default Resize Animation

<!-- scenario-metadata:end -->

## Description

Verify the `defaultResizeAnimationEnabled` property of the `FormSheet` component. This test ensures that a `fitToContents` sheet animates a change of its content height by default, and that with the property disabled the sheet follows the content height without an animation of its own – also when that height is animated from JS. It also covers the default animation when it is interrupted: by a second change of the content height, by the presentation of the sheet and by the keyboard.

## Note

- "Expand Animated Box" and "Collapse Animated Box" change the height of the box over one second with `Animated` from `react-native`, so the sheet gets a new content height on every frame.
- The buttons that name two actions ("Open FormSheet And Expand Content", "Expand And Collapse Content", "Expand Content And Hide Keyboard" and their counterparts) perform the second action 100 ms after the first one, so that it lands while the animation started by the first one is still running.
- **iOS:** the sheet has extra empty space at the bottom – the native bottom inset (home indicator area) is added below the content.

## Steps

### Baseline

1. Launch the app and navigate to the **Default Resize Animation** screen.

   - [ ] The host screen shows the "Open FormSheet", "Open FormSheet And Expand Content" and "Open FormSheet With Text Input" buttons.

---

### Presentation

1. Tap "Open FormSheet".

   - [ ] The sheet presents with a height matching its content ("FormSheet content" title, description text, "defaultResizeAnimationEnabled: true" text, "Disable Default Animation", "Expand Content", "Expand And Collapse Content", "Expand Animated Box" and "Dismiss from JS" buttons).

---

### Default animation enabled

1. Tap "Expand Content".

   - [ ] The extra text box appears and the sheet grows to fit it. The growth is animated.

2. Tap "Collapse Content".

   - [ ] The extra text box disappears and the sheet shrinks back. The shrink is animated, with no gap below the sheet.

---

### Two changes in quick succession

1. Tap "Expand And Collapse Content".

   - [ ] The sheet starts to grow, turns back from where it is and comes to rest at the height it started from. The extra text box is gone and the button reads "Expand And Collapse Content" again.
   - [ ] The movement is continuous: there is no jump and no gap below the sheet.

2. Tap "Expand Content", wait until the sheet settles, then tap "Collapse And Expand Content".

   - [ ] The sheet starts to shrink, turns back from where it is and comes to rest at the expanded height, with the whole extra text box visible.
   - [ ] The movement is continuous: there is no jump and no gap below the sheet.

3. Tap "Collapse Content".

   - [ ] The sheet shrinks back with an animation.

---

### Default animation disabled

1. Tap "Disable Default Animation".

   - [ ] The text reads "defaultResizeAnimationEnabled: false" and the button now reads "Enable Default Animation". The sheet height does not change.

2. Tap "Expand Content".

   - [ ] The extra text box appears and the sheet takes its new height at once, without an animation.

3. Tap "Collapse Content".

   - [ ] The extra text box disappears and the sheet takes its previous height at once, without an animation and with no gap below the sheet.

4. Tap "Expand Animated Box".

   - [ ] The sheet grows together with the box, frame by frame, and stops when the box stops – it does not lag behind the box.

5. Tap "Collapse Animated Box".

   - [ ] The sheet shrinks together with the box and stops when the box stops. There is no gap below the sheet.

---

### Enabling the animation again

1. Tap "Enable Default Animation", then tap "Expand Content".

   - [ ] The text reads "defaultResizeAnimationEnabled: true" and the growth of the sheet is animated again.

2. Tap "Collapse Content".

   - [ ] The shrink is animated again.

3. Tap "Dismiss from JS" (or swipe the sheet down).

   - [ ] The sheet dismisses and the host screen is undimmed; the three "Open FormSheet" buttons are pressable again.

---

### Content change during the presentation

1. Tap "Open FormSheet And Expand Content".

   - [ ] The sheet slides in and comes to rest at the height of the expanded content: the whole extra text box is visible and the button reads "Collapse Content".
   - [ ] The presentation is one continuous movement – the sheet does not stop, turn back or jump once it is presented.

2. Tap "Collapse Content", then tap "Dismiss from JS".

   - [ ] The sheet shrinks with an animation and then dismisses.

---

### Keyboard

1. Tap "Open FormSheet With Text Input".

   - [ ] The sheet presents with a height matching its content (description text, "Text input" field, "Expand Content", "Expand Content And Hide Keyboard" and "Dismiss from JS" buttons).

2. Tap "Text input".

   - [ ] The keyboard slides in and the sheet moves up, so that its whole content sits above the keyboard.

3. Tap "Expand Content".

   - [ ] The sheet grows to fit the extra text box. The growth is animated, the keyboard stays shown and the whole content stays above it.

4. Tap "Collapse Content".

   - [ ] The sheet shrinks back with an animation. No gap opens between the sheet and the keyboard.

5. Tap "Expand Content And Hide Keyboard".

   - [ ] The sheet starts to grow, then the keyboard hides and the sheet moves down along with it, without a jump.
   - [ ] The sheet comes to rest at the bottom of the screen with the whole extra text box visible.

6. Tap "Text input", wait until the sheet settles above the keyboard, then tap "Collapse Content And Hide Keyboard".

   - [ ] The keyboard hides and the sheet moves down along with it. No gap shows between the sheet and the keyboard, or below the sheet.
   - [ ] The sheet comes to rest at the bottom of the screen with the height of the collapsed content.

7. Tap "Dismiss from JS" (or swipe the sheet down).

   - [ ] The sheet dismisses and the host screen is undimmed.
